title: Global-in-time Spectral Duhamel-Picard Method for Post-Exposure Bake Simulation and Physics-Informed Neural Operators for EUV Lithography
abstract: arXiv:2610.20655v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We present a global-in-time spectral Duhamel-Picard method with polynomial expansions for post-exposure bake (PEB) simulation. The coupled acid-quencher reaction-diffusion equations are reformulated as nonlinear Volterra integral equations using the Duhamel principle. Full trajectories are represented by finite polynomial expansions, with temporal coefficient fields determined over the bake interval by Anderson-accelerated Picard iteration, thereby avoiding sequential time marching. In 3-D PEB simulations, we employ Chebyshev and Legendre temporal bases while evaluating the Duhamel integrals using the corresponding Gaussian quadrature rules. We demonstrate that the proposed method simulates a large domain of $1200\times1200\times100$ voxels on the order of one minute. translated_title: 用于曝光后烘焙模拟的全局时间谱Duhamel-Picard方法及用于EUV光刻的物理信息神经算子
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一种用于曝光后烘焙模拟的全局时间谱Duhamel-Picard多项式展开方法。利用Duhamel原理，将耦合的酸-猝灭剂反应扩散方程重新表述为非线性Volterra积分方程。完整的轨迹由有限多项式展开表示，其时间系数场通过Anderson加速的Picard迭代在整个烘焙区间内一次性确定，从而避免了顺序时间步进。在三维PEB模拟中，我们采用Chebyshev和Legendre时间基，并使用相应的高斯求积规则计算Duhamel积分。我们证明了所提出的方法可以在一分钟左右的时间内模拟1200×1200×100体素的大规模区域。该表示进一步被纳入物理信息神经算子（PINO）中，采用了分解式傅里叶神经算子的混合变换变体……
tldr: 本文提出一种全局时间谱Duhamel-Picard方法，通过将酸-猝灭剂反应扩散方程转化为Volterra积分方程并用多项式展开与Anderson加速Picard迭代求解，实现了约一分钟内模拟1200×1200×100体素的大规模三维曝光后烘焙过程，并将其融入物理信息神经算子用于EUV光刻模拟。
